from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f9737362.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)]
    def paint(r, c):
        if grid[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    # Extend horizontally from each row of the rectangle, away from any marker on that row.
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        left_marker = any(mr == r and mc < c0 for mr, mc in markers)
        right_marker = any(mr == r and mc > c1 for mr, mc in markers)
        if left_marker and not right_marker:
            spans = [(c0, w)]
        elif right_marker and not left_marker:
            spans = [(0, c1 + 1)]
        elif left_marker and right_marker:
            spans = []
        else:
            spans = [(0, c0), (c1 + 1, w)]
        for a, b in spans:
            for c in range(a, b):
                paint(r, c)
    # Project the rectangle's columns above and below, omitting columns marked on that side.
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if not any(mc == c and mr < r0 for mr, mc in markers):
            for r in range(r0):
                paint(r, c)
        if not any(mc == c and mr > r1 for mr, mc in markers):
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h):
                paint(r, c)
    return out
'''
